Gates: system bench tb_mtp_rom_s0_rtt (closed SOURCE WFC + MTP blocks through the relay stations) + link stress gate tools/mtp_seq_rtt_link_gate.py (legacy/short history overflow). Variant d: HM 10, PD 0.40.
